fusions.name: Raw Spark
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of raw arcana that hits the first enemy in its path for 9 damage. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Wild Burst
fusions.desc: A burst of raw arcana that deals 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Bent Candlelight
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickened Mind
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
